title: Advancing MLLM-based UAV Image Understanding and Reasoning: A Benchmark and a Training-Free Multi-Agent System
abstract: arXiv:2608.11738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based UAV aerial image understanding and reasoning is essential for aerial intelligence yet poses distinct challenges arising from extreme scale variation, arbitrary camera orientations, and high object density. Despite growing interest, existing evaluations remain fragmented across individual datasets and narrow tasks, leaving a critical gap in unified assessment of UAV understanding and reasoning capabilities. To fill this gap, we construct UAVQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,500 human-annotated QA pairs drawn from 13 public UAV datasets, covering 6 capability dimensions and 16 tasks in both multiple-choice and visual grounding formats. translated_title: 推进基于多模态大语言模型的无人机图像理解与推理：一个基准和一个免训练的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的无人机航拍图像理解与推理对于空中智能至关重要，但由于极端尺度变化、任意相机方向和密集物体密度，它带来了独特的挑战。尽管兴趣日益增长，现有评估仍分散在个别数据集和狭窄任务上，导致对无人机理解与推理能力的统一评估存在关键缺口。为填补这一缺口，我们构建了UAVQA-Bench，一个包含1500个来自13个公共无人机数据集的人工标注问答对的基准，涵盖6个能力维度和16个任务，包括多项选择和视觉定位格式。对UAVQA-Bench上广泛的开源和闭源MLLM以及基于智能体的系统进行的系统评估，识别出三个关键失败模式：领域工具集不匹配、未检查的错误传播和静态推理。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了一个免训练的多智能体系统。
tldr: 本文提出了一个包含1500个问答对、覆盖6个维度和16个任务的无人机图像理解基准UAVQA-Bench，并基于系统评估发现的三个失败模式，引入了一个免训练的多智能体系统来改进无人机图像推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UAVQA-Bench, a benchmark with 1,500 QA pairs covering 6 dimensions and 16 tasks for UAV image understanding, and proposes a training-free multi-agent system to address three identified failure modes in MLLM-based reasoning.
